CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Cheating in exams

2. Which response best shows understanding of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Methods of Studying the Holy Bible.
   B. Use Methods of Studying the Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Methods of Studying the Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Journey to Jerusalem has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Journey to Jerusalem to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Judges? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Judges with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Judges.
   C. Say Selected Judges has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Selected Judges to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Writing the Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Writing the Holy Bible.
   B. Use Writing the Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Writing the Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Writing the Holy Bible has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem:? (1 mark)
   A. Say Journey to Jerusalem: has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Journey to Jerusalem: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem:.

7. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Waste food daily

8. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Say Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer.

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

10. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship? (1 mark)
   A. Say Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation.
   B. Say Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Journey to Jerusalem and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Journey to Jerusalem: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
